site.name: Mona Hukuk
site.tagline: Legal counsel for international clients in Turkey
site.description: Antalya-based law firm representing foreign individuals and companies in immigration, real estate, family, criminal, labor, commercial and IT/AI law matters.

hero.title: Mona Hukuk
hero.lead: Based in Antalya, our firm provides legal counsel and litigation services to its clients with over a decade of professional experience and a team specialized in their respective fields.

home.practiceIntro: We practice in every branch of Turkish Law, serving our clients across a broad spectrum including, in particular, Commercial Law, Family Law, Labor Law, Criminal Law, Real Estate Law, and Administrative Law. We assess each case within its own circumstances and adopt a solution-oriented and transparent approach to case management.

foreignClients.title: Services for Foreign Clients
foreignClients.lead: All members of our team are fluent in English, enabling us to provide our foreign clients with high-quality legal counsel in their own language. Within this scope, we offer comprehensive services in the following areas:
foreignClients.item2: Short-term and long-term Residence Permit processes
foreignClients.item3: Legal counsel and intermediary services in bureaucratic procedures regarding the acquisition of movable and immovable property in Turkey
foreignClients.item4: Representation before the Land Registry, notary offices, and relevant public institutions

approach.title: Our Approach
approach.body: At Mona Hukuk, we believe that trust, confidentiality, and professional diligence lie at the heart of legal service. We regard our relationship with our clients as a long-term collaboration and act with the principles of open communication and accountability at every stage.
approach.closing: Should you seek reliable support in your legal matters, our office will be pleased to meet with you.

ctaBanner.title: Need legal advice in Turkey?
ctaBanner.body: Tell us briefly what you are dealing with and we will respond — usually within one business day.

about.title: About Mona Hukuk
about.lead: An independent Antalya-based law firm focused on the legal needs of foreign individuals and international businesses operating in Turkey.
about.body: Mona Hukuk advises expats, foreign investors, and cross-border companies on the full spectrum of Turkish law that affects their lives and operations in Turkey. Our practice combines local procedural expertise with international working culture: clear English communication, transparent fee structures, and case management that respects clients' time zones.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To provide foreign nationals and international companies engaged with Turkish legal processes with results-oriented legal representation that eliminates language barriers, cultural differences, and procedural complexity. As an Antalya lawyer for foreigners, we work meticulously to secure our clients' lives and business processes in Turkey.

international.title: International client focus
international.body: A team focused on working with foreign-national clients. All our lawyers communicate in English; translator coordination is provided for Russian, German, and Arabic-speaking clients.

experience.title: Over a decade of practice
experience.body: We have been managing legal processes for foreigners in Antalya for more than a decade. Practical experience across a broad spectrum from title transactions to citizenship files, criminal defence to commercial disputes.

transparency.title: Transparent fee structure
transparency.body: Fee structure with no surprises, written representation agreements, predictable cost planning per file. Clients always know what stage they're at and what they're paying.

discretion.title: Confidentiality and diligence
discretion.body: Every engagement is handled with discretion expected by private clients, executives, and investors. Information security and client confidentiality form the foundation of our professional responsibility.

about.areasIntro: We focus on the areas in which foreign clients most often interact with the Turkish legal system in Antalya:
